error.missing-upload: The uploaded file disappeared before it could be read. Upload it again.
error.missing-stats: The parsed stats are gone. Upload the file again.
error.no-storage: File storage isn't available on this site.
error.read-failed: The upload couldn't be read. Upload it again.
warning.speaker-rebuilt: MAT's speaker list had only {{before}} s for {{speaker}}, but the transcript attributes about {{after}} s to them. Used the transcript.

warning.speaker-mismatch: MAT's speaker list has {{before}} s for {{speaker}}, the transcript about {{after}} s. Couldn't fix it automatically.
warning.step-failed: The MAT step "{{step}}" failed, so its numbers are missing.
